checkedAlternates.risk: Zenith is 90° altitude in the horizon system.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Zenith is the single overhead pole point (group-1), distinct from the two horizon coordinates Azimuth and Altitude (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Right Ascension is measured eastward from the Vernal Equinox.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The Vernal Equinox is the intersection of the Celestial Equator and Ecliptic, serving as the ecliptic zero point (group-4).
